title: Width of a two-literal term
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $i$ and $j$ be distinct coordinates among $n$ coordinates. For any signs $s_i,s_j\in\{-1,1\}$, the conjunction term requiring sign $s_i$ at coordinate $i$ and sign $s_j$ at coordinate $j$ has width $2$.
